description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for different models. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, ranging from 45 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays four lines: a dark blue line with a solid style and circle markers representing "Squared-Exponential", a blue line with a solid style and circle markers representing "Tanh", a light blue line with a solid style and circle markers representing "ELU", and a pink dashed line representing "LLaMA-2-chat-7B". The dark blue "Squared-Exponential" line starts at around 54 at 0 demonstrations and increases to approximately 58.5 at 1500 demonstrations, with a notable rise between 0 and 750 demonstrations. The blue "Tanh" line begins at around 49 and reaches about 53 at 1500 demonstrations, showing a steady increase. The light blue "ELU" line starts at around 47 and ends at approximately 50 at 1500 demonstrations, also showing a steady increase. The pink "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line remains relatively constant at around 44 across the range of demonstrations.
